hunks.baseline: An endless stretch of city wall, and a massive iron gate controlling passage to the north.
hunks.sol: An endless stretch of city wall. A massive iron gate controlling passage to the north.

hunks.baseline: At the head of a thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards and several court ministers standing in formation on either side, the imperial banners bearing embroidered dragons held high, stood one man.
hunks.sol: And at the head of a thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards and several court ministers standing in formation on either side, imperial banners embroidered with dragons held high, stood one man.

hunks.baseline: The Emperor’s sudden appearance caught me off guard. Then, following his smile, I let a faint one settle on my own face.
hunks.sol: The Emperor’s sudden appearance caught me off guard. Then I returned his smile with a faint one of my own.

hunks.baseline: “My time is precious, but if it’s only for a little while, I’ll spend it on a precious meeting. As it happens, there was something I needed to tell you in person, too.”
hunks.sol: “My time is precious, but I can spare a little of it for a meeting worth having. As it happens, there’s something I need to tell you in person, too.”

hunks.baseline: “You speak as if you knew I’d be waiting.”
hunks.sol: “You sound as if you knew I’d be waiting.”

hunks.baseline: “Honestly, I didn’t expect that much. But I’m glad I get to see you, even like this.”
hunks.sol: “Honestly, I didn’t expect that. But I’m glad to see you, even like this.”

hunks.baseline: “Why not answer honestly, like you usually do? In truth, it isn’t me you’re glad to see. It’s them.”
hunks.sol: “Why not answer honestly, like you usually do? It isn’t me you’re glad to see. It’s them.”

hunks.baseline: The Emperor wasn’t the only one waiting for me in front of the North Gate of the imperial capital.
hunks.sol: The Emperor wasn’t the only one waiting for me in front of the Imperial Capital’s North Gate.

hunks.baseline: *That’s…*
hunks.sol: *Oh.*

hunks.baseline: The Thousand Captain of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, Jeong Hogun—the first face I’d seen at the imperial court, and the one I’d seen most often since—was only the beginning.
hunks.sol: Jeong Hogun, the Embroidered Uniform Guard’s Thousand Captain—the first of them I’d met, and the one I’d seen most often—was only the beginning.

hunks.baseline: Baek Yeon and Hong Jin, who should have been busier than anyone else right now, were there, too. And I spotted someone I hadn’t seen in the past few days.
hunks.sol: Baek Yeon and Hong Jin, who should have been busier than anyone else right now, were there too. And I spotted someone I hadn’t seen in days.

hunks.baseline: *Prince Shangshan. No—the Crown Prince.*
hunks.sol: *Prince Shangshan. No—the Imperial Younger Brother.*

hunks.baseline: Warmth spread through a corner of my heart. That boy, whose life had once hung by a thread, was now beside his only family.
hunks.sol: Warmth spread through a corner of my heart. That boy, whose life had once hung by a thread, was now with his only family.

hunks.baseline: I gave Zhu Bao, who sat astride his horse and looked ready to burst into tears, a faint smile. Then I turned back to the Emperor.
hunks.sol: I gave Zhu Bao, who sat in his saddle looking ready to burst into tears, a faint smile. Then I turned back to the Emperor.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve changed mine, too. You’re right—I’m happier to see them than I am to see Your Majesty.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve changed mine too. You’re right—I’m happier to see them than I am to see Your Majesty.”

hunks.baseline: His suppressed voice was accompanied by an air that instantly turned cold.
hunks.sol: His voice was low, and the air went cold at once.

hunks.baseline: But the Emperor, who had glared at me with a rigid expression for just a moment, suddenly burst into the laughter he’d been holding back.
hunks.sol: But after glaring at me for a moment, the Emperor burst into the laughter he’d been holding back.

hunks.baseline: “You never cease to amaze me. No—your behavior is downright bizarre. How can you be so arrogant and rude to the father of all the people and the supreme ruler?”
hunks.sol: “You never cease to amaze me. No—it’s downright bizarre. How can you be so arrogant and rude to the father of all the people and the supreme ruler?”

hunks.baseline: “As I’ve already told you, I’m nothing more than a mere rogue. I don’t even have an identity plaque, and I have parents of my own.”
hunks.sol: “As I’ve already told you, I’m just a rogue. I don’t even have an identity plaque, and I have parents of my own.”

hunks.baseline: At my unhesitating reply, gasps escaped from here and there.
hunks.sol: Gasps sounded here and there.

hunks.baseline: Most of the people—especially the court ministers who had no idea why they were even here—looked at one another as if to ask whether this was really happening.
hunks.sol: Most of the people—especially the court ministers, who looked as if they had no idea why they’d been brought here—glanced at one another as though to ask whether this was really happening.

hunks.baseline: “I understand now. You are neither my subject nor a citizen of the Great Nation.”
hunks.sol: “I see. You are neither my subject nor a citizen of the Great Nation.”

hunks.baseline: Without waiting for my reply, the Emperor continued.
hunks.sol: Without waiting for my reply, he continued.

hunks.baseline: “But you think and act according to justice, righteousness, and chivalry. You are truly a hero of your age, worthy of the admiration of all.”
hunks.sol: “But you think and act according to what is right, to righteousness, and to chivalry. You are truly a hero of your age, worthy of everyone’s respect.”

hunks.baseline: Clip-clop. Clip-clop.
hunks.sol: *Clip-clop. Clip-clop.*

hunks.baseline: The Emperor rode slowly toward me until he was right in front of me. He gazed at me for a moment, then suddenly raised a hand to his shoulder.
hunks.sol: The Emperor rode slowly toward me until he was right in front of me. He studied me for a moment, then reached up to his shoulder.

hunks.baseline: The tightly tied cord came loose. Without the slightest hesitation, the Emperor removed his own cloak and held it out to me, smiling faintly.
hunks.sol: The tightly tied cord came loose. Without hesitation, the Emperor removed his cloak and held it out to me with a faint smile.

hunks.baseline: The court ministers were trembling as if they’d been struck by a stroke. They could hardly believe their eyes as they stared at the cloak embroidered with a golden dragon that looked ready to spring to life.
hunks.sol: The court ministers trembled as if they’d suffered strokes, staring aghast at the cloak embroidered with a golden dragon that looked ready to come alive.

hunks.baseline: But their desperate voices were swallowed by the wind at the Emperor’s curt command.
hunks.sol: But the Emperor’s curt command swallowed them all.

hunks.baseline: In the heavy silence pressing down on those around us, the Emperor turned his gaze to me and spoke.
hunks.sol: In the heavy silence, he turned back to me.

hunks.baseline: “Take it. It’s only a small gift from me.”
hunks.sol: “Go on. It’s just a little gift from me.”

hunks.baseline: Even without everyone’s vehement reaction, I knew this wasn’t some simple gift.
hunks.sol: Even without everyone’s reaction, I knew this was no ordinary gift.

hunks.baseline: “This is… pretty far from ‘only a small gift.’”
hunks.sol: “This is… a lot more than a little gift.”

hunks.baseline: The fact that the Emperor himself had worn it already made it impossible for it to be an ordinary thing. But there was something even more important.
hunks.sol: The Emperor himself had worn it. That alone would have made it extraordinary. But something else mattered even more.

hunks.baseline: A dragon embroidered on the cloak in golden thread.
hunks.sol: A single dragon embroidered on the cloak in golden thread.

hunks.baseline: Even a three-year-old knew that this was the emblem of the Son of Heaven and the authority of the imperial house.
hunks.sol: Even a three-year-old knew it was the emblem of the Son of Heaven and the imperial house’s authority.

hunks.baseline: I could only stare at him in disbelief.
hunks.sol: I answered in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: Taken aback by this sudden turn of events, I hesitated, but the Emperor was firm.
hunks.sol: The sudden turn of events had me hesitating, but the Emperor was firm.

hunks.baseline: “Please don’t refuse. If you do, something will happen that you’ll deeply regret.”
hunks.sol: “Please don’t refuse. If you do, something might happen that you’ll deeply regret.”

hunks.sol: “Is it just me, or was none of that reassuring?”

hunks.baseline: *That we were alike.*
hunks.sol: *We were alike.*

hunks.baseline: The only difference was where we stood and what we saw. Just like me, the Emperor was only human.
hunks.sol: Only where we stood and what we saw were different. Just like me, the Emperor was human.

hunks.baseline: Just one person who had fought as best he could from the place he stood.
hunks.sol: One person who had fought as best he could from the place where he stood.

hunks.baseline: The Emperor looked at me in my cloak with satisfaction, then took a gleaming silver plaque from between the plates of his armor and held it out.
hunks.sol: The Emperor looked at me in the cloak with satisfaction, then took a gleaming silver plaque from between the plates of his armor and held it out.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, he said something that made me doubt my own ears.
hunks.sol: The next words made me doubt my ears.

hunks.baseline: “By the Son of Heaven’s authority, I appoint Jin Taekyung of the Jin Family of Taiyuan Marquis of Shangshan!”
hunks.sol: “By the authority of the Son of Heaven, I name Jin Taekyung of the Jin Family of Taiyuan Marquis of Shangshan!”

hunks.baseline: His voice, strengthened with internal energy, shattered the deep night.
hunks.sol: His voice, strengthened with internal energy, broke the deep-night silence.

hunks.baseline: His cry rang out without end. Commoners who had watched the Emperor’s procession from a distance, not daring to approach, began gathering around the torches held by the Embroidered Uniform Guards.
hunks.sol: As his declaration rang out, commoners who had watched the imperial procession from afar, not daring to approach, began gathering around the torches held by the Embroidered Uniform Guards.

hunks.baseline: As the Emperor’s solemn declaration continued to echo—
hunks.sol: The Emperor continued in a solemn voice.

hunks.sol: “I grant you as your fief more than ten counties in Shanxi Province, including Taiyuan, Honju, Yangcheon, Jeongyang, Jinzhong, Taigu, and Jiaocheng, along with the revenues of ten thousand households and a hundred thousand taels of gold and silver. In addition…”

hunks.sol: A flash of light leapt from his waist. The Emperor drew the imperial sword, his eyes gleaming as he shouted,

hunks.sol: “From this moment, I also grant you the post of Thousand Captain of the Embroidered Uniform Guard. Lead a thousand guards and, by imperial command, swiftly put down the foreign bandits who disturb the order of the realm!”

hunks.baseline: I could hardly breathe. My heart pounded.
hunks.sol: I could hardly breathe. My chest thudded.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t the sound of my heart.
hunks.sol: That wasn’t my heartbeat.

hunks.sol: The thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards standing in formation on either side were stamping their feet. They clashed their weapons and struck their armor.

hunks.baseline: The Emperor hadn’t brought a thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards here to wait for me just as an escort.
hunks.sol: The Emperor hadn’t brought a thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards here to wait for me merely as an escort.

hunks.baseline: They were an army assembled by imperial command to punish the enemy.
hunks.sol: They were a force assembled by imperial command to punish the enemy.

hunks.baseline: And at the same time, they were reinforcements prepared for me.
hunks.sol: And they were reinforcements he’d prepared for me.

hunks.baseline: My ears rang.
From the incessant chime of bells. From the shouts and cheers erupting all around me.
hunks.sol: My ears rang with the ceaseless chiming of bells and the shouts and cheers erupting all around me.

hunks.baseline: Two men had plotted a revolution, but only one had survived.
hunks.sol: Two had plotted a revolution, but only one had survived.

hunks.baseline: Having uprooted the traitors and restored everything, the Emperor hadn’t forgotten to reward those who had helped him.
hunks.sol: The Emperor had uprooted the traitors and put everything back in its place. Now he was rewarding those about to depart.

hunks.sol: The Emperor’s hand came to rest on my shoulder. The spark of life within him was slowly going out, yet I could feel the warmth of his fingertips.

hunks.baseline: Along with his voice, flowing like water, the Emperor added quietly,
hunks.sol: His voice flowed on, and he added quietly,

hunks.baseline: “Be not my subject, nor my citizen… Just be one person who shines brightly in this world.”
hunks.sol: “Be neither my subject nor my citizen… Just be someone who shines a light upon this world.”

hunks.baseline: His words, low and heavy, rang in my ears like a final testament.
hunks.sol: His low, solemn words rang in my ears like a final farewell.

hunks.baseline: Even so, the moment of parting is always bitter and full of regret.
hunks.sol: Even so, parting is always bitter. It always leaves something to be wished for.

hunks.sol: “Are you that sad?”

hunks.sol: “That’s strange.”
